algorithm: Position-based token-ID structural template + answer guessing + no-single-token-fallbacks
summary: v0.14.0 is the highest-scoring verified method. Uses 36-token structural XML template, answer letter guessing (43.8% accuracy), conclusion closing tag drafting, and gated fallbacks. Full 5-seed normalized score: 0.6771 (ratio 0.3229). Quality gates: all pass.
return_format: Returns list of token IDs. Returns [] when no confident draft available (requests ordinary AR step).

key_strategies.conclusion_closing: After answer letter appears, drafts ' </CONCLUSION>' (5 tokens)
key_strategies.answer_guessing: Category-aware heuristic, 43.8% accuracy on dev set
key_strategies.the_answer_is_pattern: Token-ID-based 'The answer is X.' pattern for complex outputs
